fp16-256.interpretation: Old engineering_passed only gated broad FP16 vs official screening. Same-FP16 attention comparison fails strict tolerance in every case; this is not accepted. Original status is preserved.

boundaries.reference: Independent NumPy float64 QK, stable softmax and weighted V; Q+bias and final output rounded to selected dtype.

prefill_stability.scope: Prefill and one decode only; not a complete-request timing benchmark.

same_runtime_pcm_comparison.reference_scope: Both runs used the same CPU-prepared reference; official captures used CUDA-prepared reference. This comparison is valid within the current runtime, not official same-input acceptance.

historical_fp16_lifecycle_note.correction: Resident worker recovery used FP16; the two staged cancellation/retry cases omitted gpt_precision and therefore used FP32. The original report label did not describe every engine. Original raw data is unchanged; the harness now propagates precision and attention to both engines.
